facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

assets.label: export transfer pumps
assets.service: tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family

control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-7113 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on P-7113 and PT-7113 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. P-7113 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 May 2007 an incident occurred on P-7113 and PT-7113 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
